'''''Bravo 2''''' was an [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] assigned to [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]]. The fighter was assigned to [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Porro Dolphe/Legends|Porro Dolphe]].<ref name="CCG-Bravo2" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Bravo 2 was damaged by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Dolphe was able to repair Bravo 2 and participate in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="CCG-Bravo2" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Bravo 2'' appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] but was first identified in the [[Theed Palace Limited]] expansion for [[Decipher]]'s ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''.
